thread:
alice: Postmortem quick sync: routing+TLS issus during yesterday's cert churn. Need clear owners for fixes + a soft mitigation.
ben: got it. timeline? customer saw retries across eu->us routes.
alice: incident window ~1806232000-1806233200. root cause: race between cert swap and route re-advertise on multi-homed edges.
carol: i'll own the LB advertise sequencing changes. i'll also add preflight checks. ETA: 2024-12-01.
dmitri: i'll own sequencer and drain semantics. plan to ensure active_conn check before advertise. ETA: 2024-11-29.
ops-bot: [incident-bot] new postmortem created: https://rwd-postmortems/2024-11-XX -- assign owners with tickets to progress.
ben: please list concrete actions here so ops can open tickets.
carol: actions: 1) serialise advertise step after cert swap (owner: carol, eta: 2024-12-01). 2) add exponential backoff on BGP advert retries to avoid flapping (owner: carol, eta: 2024-12-08).
dmitri: actions: 3) sequencer: block advertise until drain_complete & health checks pass (owner: dmitri, eta: 2024-11-29). 4) emit metric rotation_advert_gap_ms; alert p95>100ms (owner: dmitri, eta: 2024-11-30).
elaine: can we ship a short mitigation first? maybe force traffic to regional stable edges for 48h after any cert rotation. i'll patch routing policy. ETA: 2024-11-21.
alice: yes ship mitigation. also we want a canary rollout plan. keep blast radius tiny.
carol: canary: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 100% over 72h, monitor retry rate delta and latency. rollback if retries +0.2% absolute.
ben: add the dashboards/alert IDs to the ticket so SRE can wire the checks.
dmitri: noted. i'll add dashboard IDs and a synthetic traffic job for canary verification.
carol: created INFRA-4901 for advertise sequencing + backoff. link: https://rwd-issues/INFRA-4901 (ETA fields set).
dmitri: created SEC-3010 for sequencer & metrics. link: https://rwd-issues/SEC-3010.
ops-bot: [workflow] INFRA-4901 assigned to carol, due 2024-12-01. SEC-3010 assigned to dmitri, due 2024-11-29.
elaine: runbook update: i'll add emergency rollback steps and the regional fallback. runbook ticket RB-77. ETA: 2024-11-22.
ben: schedule short weekly check-ins until all tickets closed. 15m Thursdays OK?
alice: yes. i'll schedule 4 check-ins starting next week.
carol: quick config excerpt for INFRA-4901 i'll attach: ```
# advertise.conf
advertise:
  post_cert_delay_ms: 15000
  backoff: [100, 300, 1000]
```
dmitri: adding a histogram metric `rotation_advert_gap_ms` and a meter `cert_rotation_count`. will tie alerts to both.
elaine: pls put PR links in tickets when you create them so ops can validate dashboards before rollout. :thumbsup:
ben: ok closing thread. ping here for any ETA changes. thanks all.
